cohort: 145 children aged 7 to 16 years admitted for asthma and 155 controls without asthma, matched for age and admission episode
finding: No statistically significant association was found between cesarean section birth and an increased risk of asthma admission.
mod_finding: The historical proportion of cesarean sections was 4.4% higher in the asthmatic group compared to the control group, but this difference was not statistically significant.
